intro: 12 個會計情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: Good accounting is needed in all businesses.
ex.zh: 所有企業都需要良好的會計作業。

ex.en: There are a number of good software programs to help with both personal and business accounting.
ex.zh: 有不少好用的軟體可以協助處理個人與企業的帳務。

ex.en: They have accumulated more than enough information.
ex.zh: 他們已經累積了綽綽有餘的資料。

ex.en: The bills started to accumulate after the secretary quit.
ex.zh: 祕書離職後,帳單開始越堆越多。

ex.en: The company's assets are worth millions of dollars.
ex.zh: 這家公司的資產價值數百萬美元。

ex.en: A sophisticated accounting system is an asset to a company.
ex.zh: 一套完善的會計系統是公司的寶貴資產。

note: be an asset to sb/sth 對⋯是寶貴的人才或資產

ex.en: No one looks forward to an audit by the government.
ex.zh: 沒有人會期待被政府查帳。

ex.en: The independent accountants audited the company's books.
ex.zh: 獨立會計師審核了這家公司的帳冊。

ex.en: The department head was pleased that she received a 10 percent increase in her budget.
ex.zh: 部門主管很高興她的預算增加了百分之十。

ex.en: The company will have to budget more money for this department next year.
ex.zh: 公司明年必須為這個部門編列更多預算。

note: on a budget 預算有限;over budget 超出預算
budget for sth 為某事編列預算

ex.en: The firm has built up a solid reputation for itself.
ex.zh: 這家公司已經為自己建立起穩固的聲譽。

ex.en: Be careful. Your inventory of parts is building up.
ex.zh: 小心點,你的零件庫存越積越多了。

ex.en: The accountant attracted many new clients through her website.
ex.zh: 這位會計師透過她的網站吸引了許多新客戶。

ex.en: Maintaining close contact with clients keeps the account managers aware of changing needs.
ex.zh: 與客戶保持密切聯繫,讓客戶經理能掌握不斷變化的需求。

ex.en: The company has been very careful and is slowly digging itself out of debt.
ex.zh: 這家公司一直很謹慎,正慢慢擺脫債務。

ex.en: The banks are worried about your increasing debt.
ex.zh: 銀行很擔心你不斷增加的債務。

note: in debt 負債;pay off a debt 還清債務

ex.en: That client still has several outstanding bills.
ex.zh: 那位客戶還有好幾張帳單沒付。

ex.en: Clients with outstanding bills will not receive further service until the bills are paid.
ex.zh: 有未付帳單的客戶,在付清之前不會再獲得服務。

note: 另有「優秀的、傑出的」之意,如 an outstanding performance

ex.en: The company used its accountant's advice profitably.
ex.zh: 這家公司善用了會計師的建議而獲利。

ex.en: We invested in the stock market profitably.
ex.zh: 我們投資股市有所獲利。

note: profit 利潤;profitable 有利可圖的;profitability 獲利能力

ex.en: The client uses his bank statements to reconcile his accounts.
ex.zh: 這位客戶用銀行對帳單來核對他的帳目。

ex.en: The accountant found the error when she reconciled the account.
ex.zh: 會計師在對帳時發現了錯誤。

ex.en: We have had a low turnover of inventory this month and didn't bring in much money.
ex.zh: 我們這個月的存貨週轉率很低,沒賺到多少錢。

ex.en: Because of our high employee turnover we actually spend less money on salaries.
ex.zh: 由於員工流動率高,我們花在薪資上的錢其實比較少。

note: employee turnover 員工流動率;inventory turnover 存貨週轉率
